map.。房地产交易受当地限购、信贷与税费政策影响，各城市执行口径存在差异，实际操作请以: Real-estate transactions are affected by local purchase-restriction, credit and tax policies, and implementation differs by city; in practice follow the online-signed contract, appraisal report and competent-authority rules, and for major decisions consult a professional appraiser or broker.

map.首套普遍 20%–30%、二套 40%–50%，具体看城市限购与贷款政策，且受评: First homes are generally 20%-30%, second homes 40%-50%, depending on city purchase-restriction and loan policy, and affected by appraised value.
